Design
• For feasibility studies and semi-final design plans up to 65% of proposed or potential
bikeways. Please note that final design will only be approved for projects which certify in
advance of application that they will not pursue federal funding or future Bikeways funding
for construction.
• Design funding may not be used for general bicycle planning but may be used to investigate
the feasibility of bicycle improvements on specific routes serving specific objectives.
• Intended to assess issues such as environmental impacts, right-of-way issues, ADA
compatibility, local support, and cost estimates.
• Project must be completed within two (2) years of grant award.
• Maximum grant award is $400,000.
• Design funding may not be used for general bicycle planning but may be used to investigate

Minor Retrofit
• For installation of low-cost treatments to enhance bicycle routes. May include bicycle route
signing, pavement markings, bicycle parking, drainage grate replacement, automated
bicycle counters, and similar low-cost treatments.
• For state of good repair projects to resolve maintenance issues on existing bicycle routes.
This project type is meant to resolve specific state of good repair issues and is not for
ongoing maintenance.
• For Complete Streets intersection treatments where bicycle facilities are present. This may
include temporary treatments, traffic calming, and pedestrian safety benefits, in addition to
bicycle treatments
• Up to 15% of grant award may support final design for the project.
• Project must be completed within two (2) years of grant award.
• Maximum grant award is $200,000.

Construction
• For construction or installation of bikeways infrastructure. May include transportation
trails, shared-use paths and bridges, cycle tracks, bicycle lanes, and other major projects.
• Design from semi-final (65%) to final design may be funded as a component of a
construction award.
• May serve as the 20% non-federal match required for Transportation Alternatives Program
(TAP) federal construction funds. Local funds are still required for a 20% match to bikeways
contribution, equating to 4% of total construction costs required from local sources.
• Project must be completed within three (3) years of grant award or within 5 years for TAP
match projects.
• See section 6.2 for detailed information about eligible project costs.
• Maximum grant award is $500,000.
